Net Sales (NNV) = Gross - Final Value Fee - General (eBay net payout; ties to eBay "Total fees incl VAT"). General = AD_FEE (Promoted Listings "General" campaign fee, per order). PPC Cost = Advanced/Priority (CPC) ads (PREMIUM_AD_FEES) — billed per listing, allocated across the listing's orders; carried into Net Profit, not into NNV.
